# Executive Function Assignment Chunker

Subject: Intervention
Grade band: 6-8
Resource type: Student Planner
NYS framework label: NYS Learning Standards and local MTSS planning

## Short Description
A planning page that breaks a multi-step assignment into smaller actions, time estimates, and check-ins.

## Alignment Note
Supports access to grade-level tasks through organization, self-monitoring, and planning routines.

## Classroom Use Case
Use with students who need help starting projects, labs, essays, or long-term assignments.

## Preview Content
- Step I can do first
- Materials I need
- Teacher check-in point

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
